title: Fix ADR guard rule (d) crash
description: scripts/check-adrs.mjs:138 spreads pointerFiles.get(id) which is undefined for an accepted decision nothing points at, so the process dies with a TypeError before printing rule (d). Reproduced in a scratch fixture: rule (d) is unreachable exactly when it matters most, and non-accepted ADRs report it fine (inverted). Fix is a guard change: needs a red proof (the crash) and a green test flipping tests/guards/check-adrs.test.ts it.todo into a real assertion.
author: Tomislav Zorcec

comments.text:
**What changed.** `scripts/check-adrs.mjs:140` spread `pointerFiles.get(id)`, which returns `undefined` for an accepted decision no source file points at — the exact case rule (d) exists to catch. The process died with a TypeError before (d) could print, so that rule was unreachable and the contributor got only a stack trace. One-line fix: `[...(pointerFiles.get(adrIdOf(f) ?? "") ?? [])]`. The drift block already treats an empty governed set as "report under (d), skip (e)", so nothing else moved.

**Red to green proof.** The test was written FIRST against the unfixed guard: `expect(result.crashed).toBe(false)` failed with `expected true to be false` — the TypeError — 1 failed / 11 passed. After the fix the same file is 12/12 green. A second case pins non-regression: a decision WITH a governed source file stays exit 0 with no (d) message. Both assert `crashed === false`, so a future crash cannot pass silently.

**Verification.** pnpm check green: typecheck + lint + 65 tests passing, 21 todo across 14 files (63 to 65: the it.todo became a real test plus one non-regression case). Pre-commit path clean on the real repo: ADR check exit 0 (4 decisions, drift in sync), identity check exit 0. No ADR owed: the guard script carries no ADR pointer, so it is not governed code and rule (e) does not apply to it.

**Note for future agents.** tests/guards/check-adrs.test.ts assembles decision ids at runtime via `adrId()` on purpose — a literal ADR- plus four digits inside tests/ would make rule (a) fail the real repository.

No changeset: guard tooling only, no user-visible contract change.
comments.author: agent

commits.message: fix(guards): report ADR rule (d) instead of crashing on an unreferenced decision
